title: Phase 55N tests implementation trails against outcomes and local conversion gates
summary: Added a sixteen-record official collection, six Tier 1 source profiles, six new In Review signals, two In Review briefings, four organization profiles, and integrated updates across existing signals, topics, technologies, evidence gaps, local systems, and the federal research dependency map.
evidence_note: The collection preserves different implementation stages and later discontinuities. A governance action, oversight finding, versioned tool, structural milestone, purchasing channel, or preliminary draft is not converted into recipient-wide cancellation, prototype failure, commercial interoperability, building completion, agency adoption, or deployed standard.
